# @ndigo/telemetry

Isomorphic telemetry core for Ndigo — API-only: logger, metrics, severity, tracing decorators

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Public exports

- `getTraced` — Retrieves the span name declared for a traced method.
- `hasTraced` — Whether a method carries a `@traced` declaration.
- `traced` — Declares that a method runs inside an OpenTelemetry span.
- `tracedSpan` — `@traced` annotation key: the OpenTelemetry span name recorded for a method. Pass it to `hasAnnotation(...)` to select traced methods.
- `getTracedTracer` — The tracer every `@traced` method reports to.
- `TracedInterceptor` — Opens a span around every `@traced` call.
- `currentTraceContext` — Returns the active span's trace ids, or `undefined` when no span is active (no provider, or outside any span) — safe in pure-logging mode.
- `TraceCorrelation` *(type)* — The active trace context as plain ids, for stamping anything. *
- `CountedMethodConfig` *(type)* — The declaration recorded for a method decorated with `@counted`: the counter name, attributes, and optional feature aggregation.
- `CountedInterceptor` — Increments a counter for every `@counted` call.
- `countedCounter` — `@counted` annotation key: the counter declaration for a method. Pass it to `hasAnnotation(...)` to select counted methods.
- `getCounted` — Retrieves the declaration for a counted method.
- `hasCounted` — Whether a method carries a `@counted` declaration.
- `CountedOptions` *(type)* — Options for the `counted` decorator.
- `counted` — Declares that a method increments a counter on every call.
- `CounterRateSnapshot` *(type)* — Represents a snapshot of a counter's rate per second for a specific feature.
- `CounterRateAlert` *(type)* — Represents an alert triggered when a counter's rate per second exceeds a defined threshold.
- `CounterRateResolverOptions` *(type)* — Options for configuring the `CounterRateResolver`.
- `CounterRateResolver` — Resolves and monitors the rate of change for various counters across different features.
- `DurationSummary` *(type)* — Represents a statistical summary of recorded durations.
- `FeatureMetrics` *(type)* — Represents a collection of metrics for a specific feature.
- `FeatureMetricAggregatorOptions` *(type)* — Options for configuring the `FeatureMetricAggregator`.
- `FeatureMetricAggregator` — Aggregates and manages various metrics (counters, gauges, durations) for different features.
- `FeatureMetricAggregatorProvider` — The aggregator as a MetricSnapshotProvider (REV-003): projects the tracked features into the snapshot model the `/metrics` endpoint serves. Installed by `Manag…
- `FeatureMetricAggregatorAware` *(type)* — Marks an object that can receive a FeatureMetricAggregator.
- `AsFeatureMetricAggregatorAware` — Mixes feature-metric-aggregator awareness into a base class.
- `likeFeatureMetricAggregatorAware` — Tests whether a value looks like feature-metric-aggregator-aware state.
- `LazyCounter` *(type)* — A counter handle keyed by metric name: creates the instrument on first use and records `value` (default `1`) against it thereafter.
- `LazyHistogram` *(type)* — A histogram handle keyed by metric name: creates the instrument on first use and records `value` (default `1`) against it thereafter.
- `LazyHistogramOptions` *(type)* — Options for createLazyHistogram — applied to every instrument the returned handle creates.
- `createLazyCounter` — Creates a LazyCounter. Each call resolves the named instrument against the *current* global meter the first time that name is seen — the meter provider registe…
- `createLazyHistogram` — Creates a LazyHistogram with per-instrument options: the semconv unit/description and the advice bucket boundaries applied to every instrument the handle creat…
- `MetricJSONPoint` *(type)* — The JSON form of one aggregated point.
- `MetricJSONEntry` *(type)* — The JSON form of one snapshot.
- `MetricJSONView` *(type)* — The complete JSON projection: `{ metrics: { <name>: MetricJSONEntry } }`.
- `renderMetricJson` — Projects a snapshot array into the JSON view, ordered by snapshot name.
- `MetricHistogramBucket` *(type)* — One aggregated histogram bucket: `count` occurrences in `[low, high)`.
- `MetricPointValue` *(type)* — The aggregated value of one metric point.
- `MetricPoint` *(type)* — One aggregated point: the attribute set plus the aggregated value.
- `MetricSnapshot` *(type)* — The aggregated shape of one metric instrument at one collection. The `type` mirrors the OTel aggregation kind (`sum` — counters and up-down-counters; `gauge`;…
- `MetricSnapshotProvider` *(type)* — A source of metric snapshots. Implemented by the SDK-backed reader in `@ndigo/telemetry-node`; read by the management `/metrics` controller.
- `registerMetricSnapshotProvider` — Registers the process's metric snapshot source, replacing any previous registration (hot reload, tests).
- `unregisterMetricSnapshotProvider` — Clears the registered metric snapshot source — the fallback slot (when set) now answers.
- `setFallbackMetricSnapshotProvider` — Sets or clears the fallback metric snapshot source (REV-003): the aggregator-backed provider `ManagementAutoConfiguration` installs as the no-telemetry default…
- `getMetricSnapshotProvider` — Returns the metric snapshot source: the registered current provider when present, else the fallback, else `undefined` (no telemetry configured and no auto-conf…
- `sanitizePrometheusName` — Sanitizes an OTel instrument name to the Prometheus name grammar `[a-zA-Z_:][a-zA-Z0-9_:.]*`: every invalid character becomes `_`, and a leading digit gains an…
- `renderPrometheusAttributes` — Renders the attribute set as `{k="v",...}` in sorted key order. Only scalar values render; empty sets render as `{}`. Keys pass through sanitizePrometheusName…
- `renderPrometheusText` — Renders a snapshot array to a Prometheus text document. An empty snapshot array renders an empty document.
- `FEATURE_METRIC_AGGREGATOR` — Token for the application's shared FeatureMetricAggregator entry. `ManagementAutoConfiguration` registers one under the matching `'metricAggregator'` descripti…
- `SpanConfig` *(type)* — Shared span configuration for method instrumentation.
- `CountConfig` *(type)* — Configuration for counter instrumentation.
- `AbstractBaseInstrumentation` — Base class for Ndigo OpenTelemetry instrumentations.
- `ContextInstrumentation` — An OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `GenericApplicationContext` lifecycle events.
- `DispatcherInstrumentation` — An OpenTelemetry instrumentation for the `@ndigo/dispatcher` package.
- `HostInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `HostInstrumentation`.
- `LockInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `LockInstrumentation`.
- `RateLimitInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `RateLimitInstrumentation`.
- `ResilienceInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `ResilienceInstrumentation`.
- `STOMPInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `STOMPInstrumentation`.
- `CacheInstrumentation` — OpenTelemetry instrumentation for `CacheInstrumentation`.
- `HTTPClientInstrumentation` — An OpenTelemetry instrumentation for the `@ndigo/http` client.
